steps.content: You've barely set foot in Northwild and already find yourself in such a sorry state. You practically tumble your way out of the inn, the gazes of those martial heroes behind you piercing like needles. In their eyes, you've become a deceitful fiend who infiltrated their pack.

...Though they're not entirely mistaken. They pursue you relentlessly as you flee breathlessly through the streets and alleys, hoping to use the complex terrain to shake them off, but instead you become completely lost.
Just when you're becoming trapped, a very soft voice urges you from behind.
This way! Quick, turn left!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Who's talking?
The footsteps of the crowd are already close. No time to think.
Oh no, wrong way! Duck down, watch out for the darts!
You instinctively duck down as a black iron dart grazes your hair and drills into the mud wall behind you.
That's right! See the haystack by the wall? Come here, no one will find you!

You rush toward the wall corner following the voice, but miss your footing and tumble into the fluffy haystack. Just as you're about to struggle to your feet, a scrawny, dirt-covered hand presses down on your shoulder.

steps.speaker: Dirt-Covered Girl
steps.content: Don't move. Stay hidden. I'll handle them for you.
[Mountain Path]

steps.speaker: Jiewubei
steps.content: That little scoundrel runs faster than a damn mountain rat!

Radiating with internal energy, Jiewubei's every step shakes the ground, causing the muddy snow to splatter everywhere. The flying ice nearly hits the Scholar's face behind them, but General Ma Ling arrives just in time to sweep it off before resuming the pursuit.

steps.speaker: Ma Ling
steps.content: The snow's too deep. The tracks are all messy. That young man seems to have some decent skills. Perhaps we are being overly suspicious. If he really is heading to the manor, I'll have to apologize to him when we meet—and then I'll spar with him.
steps.female_content: The snow's too deep. The tracks are all messy. That young woman seems to have some decent skills. Perhaps we are being overly suspicious. If she really is heading to the manor, I'll have to apologize to her when we meet—and then I'll spar with her.

steps.speaker: Jiewubei
steps.content: I don't give a damn who he is! I'm here to stop those who don't know the rules from disturbing Northsnow Manor's peace and ruining my plans!
steps.female_content: I don't give a damn who she is! I'm here to stop those who don't know the rules from disturbing Northsnow Manor's peace and ruining my plans!

steps.content: Jiewubei doesn't give further chase, turning back while cursing under his breath. Suddenly, a grimy figure darts out from the side, appearing almost right in front of his face.

steps.speaker: Dirt-Covered Girl
steps.content: Wow! It's Master Wubei! And... oh my, all the famous heroes from the martial world! Am I dreaming?
The martial heroes are all taken aback.

steps.speaker: Xu Shen
steps.content: Young friend, have you seen a gray-robed swordsman pass by?

steps.speaker: Dirt-Covered Girl
steps.content: I... I tell your stories in town every day! Especially General Ma's legendary conquest of the mountain bandits, and Young Master Shen's generous aid to the woodcutters... Could... could I have your autographs? Just sign on my back with charcoal!

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: Quite the sweet talker, aren't you? Here, take these coins, but you'd better tell the truth. Have you seen a foreigner carrying a sword?

steps.speaker: Dirt-Covered Girl
steps.content: Oh, I can't believe Young Master Shen is talking to me... Ah, right! There was someone just now... I think they went into the woods over there? They ran so fast they just vanished in a puff of smoke!
The girl has finally said something useful. Everyone looks in the direction she points to. That winding, secluded path clearly leads away from the manor.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Everyone, please calm down. We came here today to visit the manor and discuss martial arts, not to patrol the mountains and catch people for the manor master. Causing such a commotion over some young stranger... that would hardly look dignified.

steps.speaker: Xu Shen
steps.content: You speak wisely, Doctor Yin. We are all part of the Northwild martial world, and we should stand together. We're already so close to the manor, so let us wait here for a moment. When Lady Ji arrives, we can pay our respects together to show our sincerity.

You stay crouched in the haystack, holding your breath as you watch the group of martial heroes calm down with their discussion. Before long, they are chatting and laughing, and eventually they leave.
Only when their figures completely disappear beyond the veil of snow does the girl who helped you out of trouble pull you out.
That smiling face beneath the conical hat is looking more familiar now...

options: Are you the storyteller at the foot of the mountain?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Since you recognize me, I'll tell you my name! I'm Shuang'er, the local expert who knows all the goings-on in Northwild!

With a flick of her wrist, the conical hat spins up into the air, and she catches it. Then she bends down, scoops up some snow, and wipes it across her face, washing off all the soot. It's none other than the amateur storyteller from town who tells tales to children.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: You! Do you want to go to Northsnow Manor too?
She takes out a roll of rough paper.
She gives you a "quit pretending" look and takes out a roll of rough paper.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Look what I have here!
It's a hand-drawn sketch of the manor's terrain. The lines are crude but detailed, and there's a crooked doodle of a chick in the corner with a line of small text beside it:
"Shuang'er's Secret Passage—No Idiots or Bad Guys Allowed!"
[Inn]

steps.speaker: Attendant
steps.content: Esteemed heroes, please be careful with the tables... Thank you for your patronage...

Hearing no response, the attendant crawls out from under the table warily, hands pressed together like he's praying, as he slowly opens his eyes. Seeing the chaos and the empty inn, he realizes the martial heroes are gone and breathes a sigh of relief and resignation.

steps.speaker: Attendant
steps.content: Tables and chairs, twenty coins... broken bowls and dishes, eighty coins... Sigh... The boss just lost a whole year's hard work.
Innkeeper!

steps.speaker: Attendant
steps.content: Innkeeper?
Check, please!
[Small CG: Drunk Tiger]

This place is not bad! You get to drink and watch the show... Burp! Good wine, and you kept me entertained. Northsnow Inn is such a lousy name though... You should call it... Great Tiger Tavern instead!

steps.speaker: Attendant
steps.content: Wh-what, who's talking?! Is... is the inn haunted?!

Ohh... Did I scare you? Hey, have you got anything to write with? It's not every day you run into the White Tiger Mountain Lord. I shall give you a proper five-star review. Write down what I say, okay...
Winds howl through Northwild snow, come enjoy a brawling show. Should you dare to pick a fight? Ask your aching butt, it should know!

After the bewildered attendant has scribbled down her words, he finds a ladder and climbs up to the ceiling beams for a look, only to discover that the figure has long since vanished, leaving behind two ingots of finest silver.
The inn's doors have somehow been thrown wide open, and through the wind and snow, a carefree silhouette can be seen fading into the distance.
Alright, let's go, Meowy! We'll head to that manor and have ourselves some fun. Time to catch the next show!
With a tiger's roar, the silhouette races toward the snowy mountain peak.
